fields.summary: Autonomous plan run of change set 01M6J6FDD9GXDW4AENMS6YNY63; no owner present, every question went to the arbiter. Settled: the change set serves the landed done point m2-interviews-recorded; session interview/session done skip an answer when a Decision the change set created (or, once landed, a landed Decision derived-from the session's Source) has a question field equal to the asked question verbatim; the run's capture stays the default recorder of plain owner picks and the planner writes a Decision itself only for proxy answers or rulings the capture can't word, with proxy wording and the verbatim question; no answered-by session field now. The ~6 s per rhiza apply write on the VM is out of scope here and gets its own change set. Leaves planned: capture-skips-recorded-answers and plan-guide-who-records.
